## Page 14

Official Signing Ceremony with KoLao Group
14
ZEN Group continues to advance its international expansion 
by partnering with KoLao to strengthen its presence in the 
Lao PDR market, introducing four leading restaurant brands 
at Mega Mall Vientiane. This collaboration highlights the Group’s expertise and high operational standards in bringing quality dining concepts to international markets. 
The franchise agreement reinforces ZEN Group’s 
commitment to broadening its regional footprint while 
meeting the growing consumer demand for exceptional taste and food quality. 
Overall, the partnership marks a strategic milestone in 
accelerating the Group’s franchise growth across the region.
